title: BITSCTF 2024
description:
BITSCTF 2024 is a jeopardy style CTF held by BITSkrieg, an academic team based out of BITS Pilani, Goa Campus, India. BITSCTF has been an integral part of our annual tech-fest Quark since 2017 & is the flagship event of the team for people with all ranges of experiences right from Beginner to Professional.

Competitors in this CTF can expect questions from categories like Web Exploitation, Reverse Engineering, Cryptography, Forensics, PWN, OSINT & more!

The CTF will start on 16 February 2024, 00:00 (IST) and will end on 18 February 2024, 00:00 (IST).

1. Duration of the CTF is 48 hours.
2. Maximum team size is limited to 4 members.
3. Scoring system will be dynamic.
4. There will be a dedicated discord server for contacting the CTF admins, link can be found below
5. The participants must provide a real point of contact for future notifications and to claim their prizes.
6. Participants behaving inappropriately will be immediately disqualified. This includes (but isn't limited to):
....* Sharing solutions or hints on the designated discord channel.
....* Attacking computers or applications not designated by the competition.
....* General brute force attacks over online platform unless specified.
7. In cases of possible inappropriate behavior, the decision of the CTF admin will be final.

Join our Discord for all the updates: https://discord.gg/dHnzAcadX2
Prizes worth 20k INR to be won!
